nodes.label: v0.4.0 research results
nodes.description: Bounded compiler, physics and direct MPS research results.

nodes.label: v0.4.0 validation
nodes.description: 25 tests pass; Ruff, formatting, mypy and data-integrity checks pass.

nodes.label: v0.4.0 reproduction workflow
nodes.description: Use scripts/run_v040.sh; scripts/run_all.sh retains the historical pipeline and overwrites legacy reports.

nodes.label: v0.4.0 release notes
nodes.description: Release summarizes compiler, prospective ML, symmetry, MPS and hardware readiness results.

nodes.label: Truncated 2+1D SU(2) plaquette-chain scope
nodes.description: Gauge-reduced j_max=1/2 Hamiltonian source is src/su2zx/core.py; strings are q_(N-1)...q_0. No continuum, physical SU(3) QCD, string tension, string breaking, hadronization or quantum advantage is established.

nodes.label: Historical baseline reproduction
nodes.description: 17 baseline tests, 405 fresh physics rows, 35 historical source hashes and 426-row historical dataset structure reproduce; all six strategies pass 18 bounded controls.

nodes.label: Exact logical unitary validation
nodes.description: Logical Operator equivalence explicitly uses atol=rtol=1e-10; PyZX QASM denominator cap temporarily raised to 2**40 and restored.

nodes.label: Randomized routed equivalence validation
nodes.description: Zero state plus three seeded random complex states tested at 1e-10 including initial/final layout permutations and ancilla leakage; not an exhaustive routed-unitary proof.

nodes.label: Failed compiler outputs excluded as complete pairs
nodes.description: 830 of 860 outputs pass; 30 level-2 outputs in the N=2 x=0.5 t=0.08 r=2 small-angle family fail and remain in compiler_raw_results.csv. Hardware preparation uses verified level 1.
nodes.rationale: Preserve strict numerical tolerance and exclude complete pairs instead of counting rejected outputs as valid comparisons.

nodes.label: 415 valid Basic–Teleport pairs
nodes.description: 415 complete verified paired records from 830 passing compiler outputs.

nodes.label: Five routing seeds
nodes.description: Transpiler seeds 11,19,29,37,47 vary routing while target calibration remains fixed.

nodes.label: Fixed synthetic calibration seed 7
nodes.description: ECR-only synthetic targets use target seed 7 across routing seeds.
nodes.rationale: Hold calibration fixed so routing seed variation is not confounded with target recalibration.

nodes.label: Basic–Teleport winner robustness
nodes.description: At least 80% strict count wins and matching median delta sign define robust; 33 Basic,29 Teleport,21 all-seed ties and zero seed-sensitive parameterized families.

nodes.label: Layout and topology robustness inconclusive
nodes.description: No observed matched strict-sign reversal; singleton comparisons, fixed calibration and one basis do not establish general hardware robustness.

nodes.label: Pairwise count delta and normalized regret
nodes.description: Delta is Teleport minus Basic native 2Q count; count ties execute Basic. Regret is selected excess count divided by max(minimum count,1); lexicographic count/depth/duration label is separately stored.

nodes.label: Pre-selection feature allow-list
nodes.description: Only source-circuit, generation, topology and pre-selection layout features; hashes group records but are not predictors; automatic-layout distance is an identity-placement proxy.

nodes.label: Structural grouped leakage prevention
nodes.description: Training-only standardization; historical-only GroupKFold and leave-one-size/topology/ordering-out; seed replicas remain in the same structural family.
nodes.rationale: Prevent group replicas and prospective structural families from leaking into model selection.

nodes.label: Prospective r=3 holdout
nodes.description: New sizes N=2,4,6; x=1.5,t=0.20,r=3; excluded from historical grouped model selection.

nodes.label: Frozen N/order policy
nodes.description: Frozen 2026-09-05T06:37:43.901641+00:00: Teleport for N<=3 with current ordering, Basic otherwise; frozen_design.json records timestamp/configuration SHA-256.

nodes.label: Frozen rule matches always-Basic cost
nodes.description: Prospective normalized mean regret 0.008966; differing small-N decisions are count ties. No prospective improvement is established.

nodes.label: Pairwise ML NULL
nodes.description: Grouped-selected logistic has grouped mean regret 0 versus simple-policy 0.04413761373589207, but prospective regret 0.024954265119896592 exceeds strongest-simple 0.008966498687387041.

nodes.label: Historical grouped model selection
nodes.description: Four fixed lightweight models; logistic selected with best historical grouped mean regret 0. No hyperparameter search or nested model selection; historical winner enrichment limits generalization.

nodes.label: Exploratory shallow-tree success
nodes.description: Depth-three tree has zero prospective regret but was not grouped-selected; requires a new holdout before claiming validated advantage.

nodes.label: Current/reversed/symmetry physics grid
nodes.description: 168 rows: N=2..8, r=1,2,4,8, parameter pairs (1,0.16),(2,0.32), three orderings; odd-N central and even-N two-central occupations give reflection-invariant initial states.

nodes.label: Exact Hamiltonian observable reference
nodes.description: Sparse expm_multiply of shared Hamiltonian provides exact dynamics; saves occupations, survival, energies, norm, TVD and mirror asymmetry.

nodes.label: Current Trotter ordering
nodes.description: Representative full TVD exponent 1.865777; asymptotic exponent 1.978062 at N=5,x=2,t=0.32.

nodes.label: Reversed Trotter ordering
nodes.description: Representative full TVD exponent 2.120832; asymptotic exponent 2.038107 at N=5,x=2,t=0.32.

nodes.label: Symmetry-aware Trotter ordering
nodes.description: Preserves mirror symmetry to 1.11e-15 and lowers source depth; compiler comparison has 81 passing outputs on fixed favorable synthetic line and seed 11.

nodes.label: Symmetry result MIXED
nodes.description: TVD improves in 16/56 and worsens in 40/56; energy drift improves 44/56 and worsens 12/56; mirror asymmetry improves 48/56; source depth improves 56/56.

nodes.label: Full-grid Trotter convergence fit
nodes.description: epsilon(r) proportional to r^-p fit over r=1,2,4,8, with slope standard errors.

nodes.label: Asymptotic Trotter convergence fit
nodes.description: Fit over r=2,4,8 separated from coarse-grid fit; expected second-order Strang limit is p=2.

nodes.label: Five-metric physics/compiler frontier
nodes.description: Nondominated choices per N/x/time over TVD, mirror asymmetry, native 2Q count, native 2Q depth and synthetic estimated duration; mirror residuals below 1e-10 tie; no combined weighted score.

nodes.label: Direct-observable Aer CPU MPS
nodes.description: Saves Z_i, X_i, neighboring ZZ, energies, normalized identity and compact tensors; occupations=(1-Z_i)/2.

nodes.label: Small-N direct MPS validation
nodes.description: N=5,8 compared with independent ideal-Trotter and exact-Hamiltonian references; caps 8/32/64 and thresholds 1e-10/1e-14/1e-14; maximum ideal-Trotter observable error 2.272e-09.

nodes.label: MPS scaling demonstrated through N=32
nodes.description: VALIDATED, SCALING_DEMONSTRATED; maximum validation error 2.2717472347721923e-09; maximum scaling bond-stability error 0.

nodes.label: No-statevector MPS scaling path
nodes.description: N=12,16,20,24,32 save no statevectors; tests forbid statevector-save calls. N=32 cap64 final bond10 and 72112 tensor bytes; cap32 and cap64 observables agree.

nodes.label: MPS scaling limitations
nodes.description: Short-time r=2 ideal Trotter scaling has no large-N exact-Hamiltonian accuracy claim; RSS cumulative process high-water, tensor bytes compact-state size, normalized identity not a discarded-weight bound.

nodes.label: CUDA-Q CPU PASS
nodes.description: qpp-cpu N=1,2,5 agrees within 1e-8.

nodes.label: CUDA-Q GPU blocked by hardware
nodes.description: Detected GTX 1060 Max-Q compute capability 6.1; no unsupported GPU execution or driver modification; no GPU tensor-network scaling claim.

nodes.label: IBM metadata unavailable and QPU not run
nodes.description: Repository-only credential scope yields metadata NOT_AVAILABLE; zero QPU jobs submitted.

nodes.label: 120 synthetic hardware-ready circuits
nodes.description: Current/symmetry x Basic/Teleport x five times x six measurement bases; live comparison recompiles for a chosen real backend.

nodes.label: Exact/Trotter/compiled/hardware comparison hierarchy
nodes.description: Analysis distinguishes exact Hamiltonian, ideal Trotter, compiled ideal, raw hardware and mitigated hardware outputs.

nodes.label: One-use QPU submission guard
nodes.description: Requires ALLOW_IBM_QPU_SUBMISSION=1, --submit and exact fresh --confirm token; bound to configuration/manifest and expires after 15 minutes; synthetic bundle must be regenerated on real backend.
